offers_products.reason: Produces potash, Trio (potassium magnesium sulfate), salt and magnesium chloride for agriculture, animal feed and industry.

offers_services.reason: Water sales and water services to oil and gas operators are a secondary but named offering.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are fertilizer distributors, feed manufacturers, agricultural retailers and oil and gas operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Fertilizer and feed minerals are consumables bought seasonally by repeat distributors and customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Fertilizer and feed inputs are essential agricultural consumables; oil and gas water demand is somewhat cyclical but secondary.

big_ticket.reason: Fertilizer and mineral products are bulk consumables bought frequently, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from mined and processed potash, Trio and salt, a commodity product business.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly agricultural distributors, retailers and feed makers, a mix of mid-sized firms, not mainly large enterprises.
